definitions.explanation: The quality of being interesting, appealing, or entertaining. Often used to discuss what makes something engaging or, when negated, what makes it dull.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{面白味|おもしろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面白味|おもしろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It has the charm of being handmade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面白味|おもしろみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{感|かん}じられない→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't feel the fun of work if you just follow the rules.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧ (interesting/fun) + the suffix み, which converts an adjective into a noun expressing that quality. Very commonly used in negative constructions like {面白味|おもしろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (lacking interest).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {面白味|おもしろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to lack interest; to be dull
- {面白味|おもしろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have charm/appeal
- {面白味|おもしろみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to be lacking in interest
- {面白味|おもしろみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel the appeal of something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧: charm, attraction — more broadly applicable; used for people and things
- ⟦{醍醐味|だいごみ}→醍醐味：14412_daigomi⟧: the real pleasure/essence — stronger; refers to the ultimate enjoyment of something
- ⟦{趣|おもむき}→趣：09072_omomuki⟧: elegance, taste — more refined and aesthetic; suggests depth and subtlety

USAGE:
This word appears more frequently in negative or questioning contexts than in positive ones. {面白味|おもしろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ is a common criticism meaning something is bland or uninspiring. Also written as {面白|おもしろ}み with hiragana み.
